messages:
emily: Heads-up — finalizing customer-facing summary for yesterday's outage. Who signs off on statuspage wording + RCA sharing? I think we need legal + eng lead. cc @priya :eyes:
incident-bot: Postmortem draft uploaded: https://redwood.internal/pm/RI-1234-draft (auto-tagged)
priya: Legal note: prefer redaction of customer names unless we have explicit consent. Avoid publishing config/PII. I'll do a quick checklist review and flag anything risky.
matt: From eng: agree on structure — timeline, impact, mitigation, next steps, and follow-up owners. Suggested statuspage blurb below:
```We experienced an intermittent routing issue between inference nodes which caused delayed responses for a subset of requests. Mitigation: failing requests were rerouted within 8 minutes, and the service was stable after the mitigation. If you believe you were affected, contact support for confirmation. We will follow up with a detailed summary once legal sign-off is complete.```
alyssa: SGTM. Also propose we add an opt-in flow for the full unredacted RCA (request form + verification). We had a customer upset last time when sensitive config snippets were included.
devon: Who owns updating the public statuspage template and the customer outreach wording? Can we assign to @matt? ETA EOD tomorrow would be ideal.
priya: I can sign off on legal phrasing by 11:00am tomorrow. For RCA sharing policy: default = public redacted summary + private unredacted RCA to authorized contacts on request (requires consent/NDA where applicable). Let's add that to the comms playbook.
emily: Action owners so far: matt — update statuspage template and paste final blurb; priya — legal sign-off; alyssa — draft customer outreach + opt-in wording. I'm adding these to the incident action tracker now. :memo:
matt: :thumbsup: I'll drop the updated blurb into the doc and update the template. Quick Q — do we use 'affected customers' or 'may have been affected'? Legal usually prefers the latter unless we have confirmed IDs.
priya: Use 'may have been affected' unless support has validated a concrete list. If we can confirm, call out specifics during private outreach only.
emily: Please also add these checklist items to the postmortem: - consent obtained for unredacted RCA (Y/N) - redaction log recorded and stored - notify impacted customers timeline recorded - add recurring-incident review item to monthly reliability review
ops-bot: Reminder: 72h summary due by 1717887634 (72 hours from root).
lia: I'll coordinate customer outreach and triage requests. If customers request full RCA, route to cs-escrow@redwood.com and loop in priya for legal clearance.
emily: Thanks everyone — I'll hold off on publishing the statuspage until priya signs off and matt drops the final blurb. Filing action items: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-1234 — please update ownership/ETA there. :white_check_mark:
